hidl_method_routes.asBinder: local HIDL HwBinder identity; must retain real native death awareness
hidl_method_routes.authenticate: native.authenticate(opId,activeUser,secureLevel,emptyFido); arm Camera2 feed only on real success
hidl_method_routes.cancel: native.cancelAuthentication/cancelEnrollment/cancelEnumeration according to active operation; stop Camera2
hidl_method_routes.debug: IBase diagnostic only; never biometric operation
hidl_method_routes.enumerate: native.enumerate; emit only callbacks from real engine/template store
hidl_method_routes.getAuthenticatorId: native.getAuthenticatorId -> OptionalUint64; must be actual engine ID
hidl_method_routes.getFeature: must query genuine state; return non-success until verified
hidl_method_routes.getHashChain: IBase deterministic descriptor/hash contract; generate from official HIDL interface
hidl_method_routes.interfaceChain: IBase chain includes vendor 2.0, face 1.0, IBase
hidl_method_routes.linkToDeath: register actual native Binder death relay or return failure
hidl_method_routes.onTransact: HwBinder dispatch if remote use, all method IDs/flags; typed local invocation can bypass
hidl_method_routes.ping: IBase liveness only; validate transport connection separately
hidl_method_routes.queryLocalInterface: return this for matching vendor HIDL descriptor
hidl_method_routes.resetLockout: require real signed HardwareAuthToken and native support; otherwise fail closed
hidl_method_routes.revokeChallenge: native.postEnroll iff protocol confirms challenge revocation; otherwise fail closed
hidl_method_routes.sehCloseTaSession: native.request(SESSION_CLOSE, empty buffers, 0); propagate real result
hidl_method_routes.sehGetEngineVersion: query actual TA/native version; null if unimplemented
hidl_method_routes.sehGetSecurityLevel: native.request(GET_SECURITY_LEVEL) and callback actual result; never hardcode biometric strength
hidl_method_routes.sehGetTaInfo: query actual TA/native metadata; null if unimplemented
hidl_method_routes.sehIsTaSessionClosed: native.request(SESSION_STATUS); validate semantics before mapping boolean
hidl_method_routes.sehOpenTaSession: native.request(SESSION_OPEN, empty buffers, 0); propagate real result
hidl_method_routes.sehPauseEnrollment: native.request(SET_PAUSE) only after verifying expected argument; otherwise fail closed
hidl_method_routes.sehResumeEnrollment: native.request(SET_PAUSE) only after verifying expected argument; otherwise fail closed
hidl_method_routes.sehSetCallback: native.init(real IFaceDaemonCallback); native.openHal; deliver callbacks through Android16 typed framework converter
hidl_method_routes.sehSetFaceTag: unsupported unless real native request code/semantics recovered; fail closed
hidl_method_routes.setActiveUser: native.setActiveGroup(user, UTF8 /data/system/users/<user>/bio/fr); use isolated data namespace
hidl_method_routes.setCallback: same genuine callback setup as sehSetCallback; no simulated success
hidl_method_routes.setFeature: native request only after exact feature contract verified; otherwise fail closed
hidl_method_routes.userActivity: no-op IBase behavior; not an authentication result

onEnrollResult.require: native face ID and remaining count; never manufacture enrolled template

onAuthenticated.require: positive face ID allowed only with original exact 69-byte HAT from secure engine; correct user/op

onAcquired.route: native onAcquired -> typed Android16 AidlResponseHandler.handleResponse to active AcquisitionClient

onError.require: propagate errors and cancel outstanding operation

onRemoved.require: emit only after native template deletion

onEnumerate.require: verify all native group IDs match active user
